decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1605 EX00, 1605 EX01, 1605 EX02, 1605 EX03,1605 EX04, 1605 PA01 Rev. A,1605 PA02, 1605 PA03 Rev. A, 1605 PA04, Flood Risk matrix (unnumbered, no date), Design and Access Statement prepared by Thomas de Cruz Architects (unnumbered, no date). Received on 20 June 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
